.name: Modify Steam Cart
.note: Add a selected package or bundle, remove one exact line, or clear the current cart using the approval card.
.description: Add a selected package or bundle, remove one exact line, or clear the current cart using the approval card.
.parameters.operation: add to add a package or bundle, remove to remove one line, or clear to show and confirm all current lines.
.parameters.appId: The numeric AppID. For a free license, provide the AppID or URL.
.parameters.lineId: The exact cart line ID returned by the cart tool, as a string.
